column1: NOTE 1:The sub-band configuration is represented as a bitmap where ‘1’ indicates that a sub-band is transmitted and ‘0’ indicates a sub-band is not transmitted.  The bitmap is ordered with MSB mapped to the lowest frequency sub-band and LSB mapped to highest frequency sub-band within the wideband channel.NOTE 2:Only contiguous sub-band configuration applies to PSCCH/PSSCH. Both contiguous and non-contiguous sub-band configuration apply to PSFCH and S-SSB.
